attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory (owned root:dropusers, mode 1777 with sticky bit) so all members of the dropusers group can create files but only file owners (or root) can delete/rename others' files. Verified with two test users before and after a full node restart; boot ID changed confirming a genuine reboot, and sticky-bit enforcement plus directory ownership/permissions persisted correctly after recovery.
